edit.ability:
(OFS) Auto-equip Frostmourne.
(1PG)(OYT) Summon up to 3 different dead prime creatures as offensive minions with -2 bars in all of their base stats (reductions apply to summoned minions and revives).
May summon each minion on a slot of your choosing.
These minions are destroyed at the end of each of their turns. This effect persists through revives.
Minions inherit [undead].
